engine.head.casting.name: Cylinder head
engine.head.casting.notes: Layout from Haynes Fig 1.5 (plan of the head with nut order), scaled so the eight valves fit the published 14.031 in rocker shaft. Bathtub chambers, siamesed inlet ports (two inlet, three exhaust: FIA homologation 3016), pushrods on the manifold side, plugs on the right-hand side. Water jacket, oilways and core detail are not modelled, so the model is solid where the real casting is hollow (about 4.5 litres of iron, heavier than the real head).

specs.label: Head nut torque
specs.note: Tighten half a turn at a time in the Fig 1.5 order

specs.label: Length
specs.ref: Fig 1.5 scaled at 0.451 mm per 300-dpi pixel, set by fitting the eight valves to the 356.4 mm rocker shaft

specs.label: Height
specs.ref: Deck to top face, set by the valve, spring and guide stack (guide fitted height 0.625 in, Haynes p22)
